title: First Lessons: Stars
introNarration: Mentor Lumen keeps the hearth dummy in sight. Brass instruments wait beside a star-wheel. The air smells of ink, cold glass, and lamp-oil. "Look around this hearth. Charts before wonder. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy. Then come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves in your Field Primer."
reminderNarration: Look around this hearth. Defeat the hearth dummy here. Then talk to Lumen. The star-wheel has not moved.
completionNarration: Lumen inks three starter leaves at rank 1. A little lamp-oil shines on the nib and is gone. The next lesson will ask you to cast.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Lumen.
